title: appointment.cancel input
description: Input for appointment.cancel: cancel an existing appointment. Risk R4; confirmation and authentication required.

appointment_reference.description: Reference of the appointment to cancel, obtained from an authorized appointment lookup.

confirmation_token.description: Token proving explicit user confirmation bound to this exact normalized cancel action.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key that makes retries of the same request safe.

governance.validated_by: dr. Ferdi Andriska, S.H., M.Kn., CMDC
